name: Stone picker and collector
definition: Tractor implement that lifts stones from a field and collects them in a hopper or windrows them for removal.
reason: Landwirt sells stone collectors as their own category (34 listings); no tree kind clears stones; clearing fits leaf C7.2.2.
Stubble names the use, not the form; tine stubble cultivators are chisel and tine cultivators, disc ones disc harrows (memo 4b).

name: Seed potato cutter
definition: Machine that cuts seed potatoes into planting pieces before they go into the potato planter.
reason: Sold under its own name by a potato-machine maker; prepares seed for planting, a job no seeding kind does.
Indian implement forming small earth bunds round irrigation basins; regional name under the bund-forming kind (C11), non-maker-bound, region IN.
Landwirt lists it under potato harvesters; lifting into a bunker or onto the ground is an attribute of the potato harvester.
Tractor mulcher is the rotary cutter and flail mower (C14 b); the forestry mulcher is C7.9.07 (homonym, C9).

name: Forestry crane
definition: Hydraulic loading crane made to be fitted to a forwarder, harvester or timber trailer; new leaf C7.10.3 Forest machine fittings.
reason: Mascus sells forwarder and harvester cranes as categories; a fitting with no job away from its host machine goes to the parts sub-family (S3).

name: Log grapple and rotator
definition: Grapple, with its rotator, made to be fitted to a forestry crane or knuckleboom to grip logs.
reason: Mascus lists grapples as their own forestry accessory category; fits one machine class, so parts sub-family (S3).

name: Livestock EID panel reader
definition: Fixed reader mounted on a race or crush that reads livestock electronic ear tags as animals pass.
reason: Tru-Test sells panel readers apart from stick readers; fixed mount and different form (C12 a), same identification stage.

candidate: Cattle race and circular handling system
name: Cattle race and handling system
definition: Race, forcing pen or circular tub that moves and lines up cattle at herd scale toward a crush.
reason: Sold as its own range beside crushes; K-101 names handling systems as C7; no tree kind holds races and forcing pens.
Pens of posts and rails are fencing and gates (K-195, step 32): C8.
Restrains one cow for insemination or treatment: the cattle crush and headgate kind.
Restrains one calf for treatment: cattle crush and headgate; size is an attribute (C6).
Dryer type (in-bin, continuous flow, tower, mixed flow) is an attribute of the grain dryer.
Tree kind C7.1.1.06, filed under tractors by C14 b and shown in Forestry by a view.
A sawmill cuts timber; not drawn by or mounted on a tractor nor a self-propelled forest machine (step 12): C1 wood-cutting machine.
A feed cart delivering feed along cages is one form of the poultry feeding line; delivery method is an attribute.
A component of the poultry feeding system, not a type sold under its own generic name as a machine; no kind.

candidate: Four-track tractor (9RX, Quadtrac, Xerion TRAC TS, 8RX)
name: Four-track tractor
definition: Tractor running on four separate track units, one at each corner, in place of wheels; articulated or rigid frame.
reason: Harvested rows show it; crawler (two full tracks) and articulated 4WD (wheels) definitions both exclude it; running gear is the leaf axis.

name: Front ballast weight
definition: Ballast weight block or set of suitcase weights fitted to a tractor's front frame or three-point hitch.
reason: Sold beside wheel weights as its own type; the wheel weight kind is fitted to the wheel only.
Rear grader blade and land leveller holds land planes and levelling frames.
Setter and hatcher are stages of commercial incubation; single or multi-stage is an attribute.
Stall layout inside a static parlour is the attribute stall_layout (memo 4b).
Processor heads are harvester heads; mount (excavator or harvester) is an attribute.
